note: What a server sends to change something about a prop already on the map. The kind of change is named inside it, and the fields around the kind are read the same way whatever it is. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: name
fields.note: A name: an animation's, a particle's or a look's, by the change below. A server leaves the bytes after its end as it found them.

fields.name: first
fields.note: A figure the change reads. 0 in most of those observed.

fields.name: value
fields.note: A value the change reads. 0, 1 and 2 observed.

fields.name: change
fields.note: What changes. A client does nothing for any other value, nor where prop names no prop it holds.

0.name: animate
0.note: Play the animation name, with value as its flags, starting at first (match time in seconds) for second seconds; option nonzero removes the prop afterwards. effect and point unread.

1.name: linkEffect
1.note: Drive the prop's particle value effect from capture point point; option must be zero, or the change is refused. name, first, second and value unread.

2.name: look
2.note: Change the prop's look to name, numbered value. The rest unread.

fields.name: option
fields.note: For animate, nonzero to remove the prop after the animation; for linkEffect, zero.

fields.name: effect
fields.note: For linkEffect, which of the prop's effect values to drive.

fields.name: point
fields.note: For linkEffect, which capture point drives it.

fields.name: name
fields.note: The name the change loads, such as a set of movements the prop plays. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

fields.name: startsAt
fields.note: When the change begins, in milliseconds of match time. Observed 0, and within five milliseconds of 1000, 21000 and 41000.

fields.name: lasts
fields.note: How long the change runs, in seconds. Observed 0, 17.5 and 20.

fields.name: prop
fields.note: The prop changed, by the name MapProp gave it.

fields.name: flags
fields.note: How the change is made. The bits within are undetermined, and it is observed 1, 2.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What sort of change it is. It is observed 1 in every payload captured, and what the other kinds carry is not recorded here.

fields.name: byteA
fields.note: Purpose undetermined. It is zero in everything observed.

fields.name: byteB
fields.note: Purpose undetermined. It is zero in everything observed.

fields.name: byteC
fields.note: Purpose undetermined. It is zero in everything observed.
